text: Salted fresh cheese is packed into a jar and covered with a sour pickle; fermentation runs for a year or more, giving a very salty, sharp, soft cheese.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The cheese is layered with salt.
The cheese is sealed in an earthenware jar under a sour liquid of buttermilk, sour skimmed milk, whey and red and green peppers, with a little older mish as starter.

processing.text: The jar is topped up as cheese is taken out and fresh added, so there is no fixed age.
